elements.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
elements.evidence: HDI expressly must “defend” the Company and its affiliates.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
elements.evidence: HDI must indemnify the Company and its affiliates against “any third-party claim” arising from the listed matters.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: Coverage includes allegations that the Site, Services, or any HDI-provided deliverable infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: Clause (a)(ii) expressly covers HDI’s breach of applicable law.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: Clause (a)(iii) covers unauthorized access to or disclosure of Company data or Confidential Information caused by HDI.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
elements.evidence: Clause (a)(iv) expressly covers HDI’s gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
elements.evidence: The indemnified Party must give prompt written notice of the claim.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
elements.evidence: The indemnifying Party is given control of the defense and settlement.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
elements.evidence: The indemnified Party must provide reasonable cooperation in the defense.

elements.element: Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: The Company indemnity applies only to claims arising from Company-provided Content or the Company’s breach of applicable law.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
elements.evidence: HDI indemnifies the Company against third-party claims alleging infringement or misappropriation by the Site, Services, or HDI deliverables.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-modification exclusion is included; the permissive exclusion is therefore not implicated, and coverage is broader than required.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
elements.evidence: No Customer-combination exclusion is included; the permissive exclusion is therefore not implicated, and coverage is broader than required.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-specification exclusion is included; the permissive exclusion is therefore not implicated, and coverage is broader than required.

elements.element: Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no obligation to procure continued use, modify, or replace an infringing item.

elements.element: Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
elements.evidence: The clause provides no refund remedy if the other infringement remedies are unavailable.

elements.element: Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
elements.evidence: No three-times-annual-fees super-cap appears in the rendered language.
